info.title: Mentorship Platform
info.description:
## Mentorship Booking Platform API

A production-ready backend for connecting mentors and mentees.

### Features
- 🔐 JWT Authentication with role-based access (mentor, mentee, admin)
- 👨‍🏫 Rich mentor profiles with tags, ratings, and reviews
- 📅 Availability slot management with conflict detection
- 📋 Booking system with full status lifecycle
- ⭐ Review system tied to completed bookings
- 🔍 Advanced search with keyword, industry, price, and tag filters
- ⚡ Redis caching for search results
- 📧 Background email notifications

get.description:
Search and filter mentors.

**Keyword search** (`keyword`) matches across:
- `full_name` (boosted 3×)
- `industries` (boosted 2×)
- `tags` (boosted 1.5×)
- `title`

**Filters** (all optional, combinable):
- `title` — fuzzy match on the mentor's job title
- `industry` — one or more industry names; repeatable: `?industry=Fintech&industry=SaaS`
- `tags` — one or more tag slugs/names (with or without `#`); repeatable: `?tags=ProductManagement&tags=UX`
- `min_price` / `max_price` — hourly rate range
- `available_this_week` — mentors with free slots in the next 7 days
- `instant_booking` — instant booking, no 24 h approval required
- `evenings_weekends` — slots after 17:00 or on Saturday / Sunday
- `is_professional_counselor` — professional counselors only
- `is_academic_counselor` — academic counselors only (combine both flags to find mentors who are both)

**Sorting** (optional):
- `sort_by` — `rating` | `price` | `reviews` | `created_at` | `years_of_experience`
- `sort_order` — `asc` | `desc` (default: `desc`)
- When `keyword` is set and `sort_by` is omitted, results rank by relevance score.

**Category / Subcategory filters** (from catalog):
- `academic_category`, `academic_subcategory`
- `professional_category`, `professional_subcategory`
Use exact names from `GET /catalog/categories`.

Use `GET /catalog/tags` and `GET /catalog/industries` for the full public lists.

post.description:
Submit a request to become a mentor. Only authenticated users can apply.

This is a lightweight signal. After admin reviews and changes the user's role
to "mentor", they can create their full profile at POST /mentors/profile.

**Example request:**
```json
{
    "keyword": "System Design, Distributed Systems",
    "industry": "Technology",
    "note": "I have 8 years experience leading engineering teams..."
}
```

get.description:
Get a signed upload URL that the frontend can use to upload directly
to Cloudinary. This is the recommended production approach as it
bypasses your API server for large file uploads.

Dynamic QR payments don't require bank selection — returns an empty list.

post.description:
Initiate a Fonepay Dynamic QR payment for a booking.

Returns a base64 QR image and a PRN for status polling.
Idempotent: returns the existing pending transaction if one is still valid.

No authentication required — the booking UUID itself acts as the secret.

get.description:
Poll payment status for a transaction.

If the transaction is still pending, calls the Fonepay status API and
updates the record if payment has completed.

No authentication required — the transaction UUID itself acts as the secret.
List all transactions within a date range. Admin only.
Export transactions as CSV. Admin only.
Get a single transaction by ID. Admin only.

get.description: Return the authenticated mentor's own Calendly link.

Return a mentor's Calendly scheduling URL (public).

Used by the booking page to decide whether to show the Calendly widget.

Return prefill data for the Calendly embed widget.

The frontend calls this after creating a booking to get the data needed
to open the Calendly widget with the user's name, email, and booking_id
pre-populated.

**Query params:**
- `booking_id` — the platform booking UUID to link the Calendly event to
- `name` — user's full name (optional, prefills the widget form)
- `email` — user's email (optional, prefills the widget form)

post.description:
Receive and process Calendly webhook events.

Supported events:
- `invitee.created` — a new booking was made via Calendly
- `invitee.canceled` — a Calendly booking was cancelled

Signature verification uses HMAC-SHA256 with the `CALENDLY_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY`
environment variable. Set this to the signing key from your Calendly
developer settings.

This endpoint is idempotent: duplicate events for the same Calendly event URI
are silently ignored.
